Good to know

Frequently asked questions

Who can use Smart Learning?

Smart Learning is designed for Sri Lankan Advanced Level students across Physical Science, Biological Science, Commerce, Arts and Technology streams.

Can I access lessons on my phone?

Yes. The interface is responsive and works on desktop, tablet and mobile browsers.

Are the demo accounts real accounts?

No. This frontend prototype stores demo data in your browser using localStorage. It does not connect to a live server.
